parts.name: spider center

physics.Basic_description: Central cross-shaped component of the universal joint, appearing as a solid metal block in the center.
physics.Functional_description: Connects the two yokes and allows rotation between them.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and internal to grasp effectively.
physics.reason: The spider is a forged steel component designed to transmit high torque, typically solid or thick-walled.

parts.description: Central cross-shaped component of the universal joint, appearing as a solid metal block in the center.
parts.function: Connects the two yokes and allows rotation between them.

parts.name: journal x

physics.Basic_description: Cylindrical pin extending from the spider center along the X-axis.
physics.Functional_description: Bearing surface for the yoke cap to rotate around.
physics.Grasped_description: Not intended for grasping; it is a bearing surface.
physics.reason: Hardened steel journal pins are solid to withstand shear forces.

parts.description: Cylindrical pin extending from the spider center along the X-axis.

parts.name: journal y

physics.Basic_description: Cylindrical pin extending from the spider center along the Y-axis.
physics.Functional_description: Bearing surface for the other yoke cap to rotate around.
physics.Grasped_description: Not intended for grasping; it is a bearing surface.
physics.reason: Hardened steel journal pins are solid to withstand shear forces.

parts.description: Cylindrical pin extending from the spider center along the Y-axis.
parts.function: Bearing surface for the other yoke cap to rotate around.

parts.name: shaft yoke

physics.Basic_description: Large U-shaped metal fork (yoke) with a cylindrical shaft, painted light grey/white.
physics.Functional_description: Connects to one shaft and holds one axis of the spider.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical shaft section or the outer arms of the yoke firmly.
physics.reason: The shaft portion appears to be a tube to save weight, while the yoke arms are thick castings; modeled as hollow shell overall.

parts.name: cap pos

physics.Basic_description: Circular metal cap covering the bearing cup on the positive side of yoke A.
physics.Functional_description: Encloses the needle bearings and retains the spider journal.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and flush to grasp reliably.
physics.reason: Bearing caps are cup-shaped shells enclosing the roller bearings.

parts.name: bore liner

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
